description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the branching ratio, denoted by the label $\gamma_B$, across different trial configurations categorized by the number of shots. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Number of Shots" and displays the values 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 in ascending numerical order. The vertical value axis represents $\gamma_B$ on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to just above 0.7, with numeric tick labels positioned at regular intervals of 0.2 and accompanied by dotted horizontal grid lines spanning the plot area. The data is visually arranged into grouped bars, with a side-by-side pair of bars at each number of shots corresponding to the outcomes defined in the top legend. The "Incorrect" outcome is depicted by slate blue bars filled with a dotted pattern, positioned on the left of each group, while the "Correct" outcome is represented by dark magenta bars with diagonal hatching, positioned on the right; all bars are emphasized with solid black outlines. Visually, the bar heights exhibit a consistent downward trend as the number of shots increases from 0 to 4 within both legend categories. The tallest bar in the chart represents the "Correct" outcome at 0 shots with an approximate value of 0.72, while the shortest bar corresponds to the "Incorrect" outcome at 4 shots with an approximate value of 0.30. Within the groups, the "Incorrect" values range from about 0.41 at 0 shots down to 0.30 at 4 shots, and the "Correct" values range from roughly 0.72 at 0 shots down to 0.45 at 4 shots.
